notes.how: Code measures on the workstation with `fov-render check --blend classroom_eye.blend --device OPTIX --only S1 S2 --write-spec DRAFT`, Chat reviews, the reviewed values replace the nulls and to_measure goes (issue #18)
notes.max_hole_fraction: f3d-vision measured 0.0208 holes (window panes onto a featureless world; OPTIX, 2026-09-12, scenes/manifest.json), above the default limit 0.02: the draft keeps 0.02 and says it will fail. Whether the Classroom gets its own limit is Luiz's decision (issue #18)
notes.backface_allowed: f3d-vision measured 0.0038 back-faces from this EYE (scenes/manifest.json), above 0.001: which objects, and whether they are closed meshes, is for S2 to say
notes.missing_images: f3d-vision's asset manifest resolves every image (0 missing); S1 checks it in fov_render
